package.name: ros2_uds_ipc
package.description: A thin library for publishing and subscribing rclcpp message types as-is over AF_UNIX SOCK_SEQPACKET. It bypasses DDS discovery, QoS matching and the RTPS protocol layer, and is meant for event-driven paths that need low-latency delivery across processes (e.g. ros2_control -> CAN API). SOCK_SEQPACKET guarantees delivery at the kernel level, so it is not best-effort.
